reference: Olkiluoto, Finland, crystalline bedrock (no published log for these boxes)

description.lithology: Veined/migmatitic gneiss - medium to dark grey with irregular white to light grey leucocratic quartz-feldspar bands/leucosome. Medium-grained groundmass. Banded and foliated gneissic fabric with veined, locally folded migmatitic texture.
description.alteration: none visible - no distinct chloritic, sericitic, silicified, potassic, carbonate or oxidised alteration distinguishable; pale mottling is primary leucosome/banding, not alteration.
description.mineralization: none visible - no clearly identifiable sulfide grains, veinlets, blebs or massive accumulations at this photo resolution.

anomalies.explanation: Sharp diagonal fracture/break at about 2/3 down-hole with offset of the red orientation line should be checked for natural vs drilling-induced origin.
Small broken/crushed core fragments clustered at the up-hole (left) end adjacent to the 26.70 depth block should be checked.
